_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Test Equipment Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M)
summary: Documents the status of the contractor's effort toward achieving contract objectives, identifying accomplishments and difficulties, and comparing status to planned goals and resources for use by the Government in monitoring and evaluating contractor performance.
use_relationship:
The Test Equipment Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) documents the status of the contractor effort towards achieving contract objectives. It identifies accomplishments to date and difficulties encountered, and compares the status achieved to planned goals and the resources expended. It is used by the Government to monitor and evaluate contractor performance.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The POA&M shall be in contractor's format. The report shall be a readable/editable version in Microsoft Project and a separate electronic copy in Adobe's Portable Document Format (PDF).  The report's narrative shall be submitted as a PDF.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The POA&M shall contain the following:

children.title: Discrete tasks/activities
children.content: (including planning packages where applicable) from contract award to the completion of the contract.

children.title: Vertically and horizontally traceable
children.content: to the cost/schedule reporting instrument used to address variances.

children.title: A numbering system
children.content: that provides traceability to the Statement of Work, where applicable.

children.title: Contractual milestones and descriptions
children.content: and display summary, intermediate, and detailed schedules, and periodic analysis of progress to date.

children.title: Monthly analysis of schedule progress to date
children.content: and shall include changes to schedule assumptions, variances to the baseline schedule, causes for the variances, potential impacts, and recommended corrective actions to minimize schedule delays. The analysis shall also identify potential problems and an assessment of the critical path and near-critical paths.

children.title: Work that has been accomplished since the last POA&M update
Any work that needs to be accomplished by the Government
children.content: Describe, in detail, risk/consequences of work not being performed.  Detail when the described work needs to be completed by.

children.title: Any/All Delays
children.content: Detail the cause, length, risk, and remedy plan.

children.title: Describe, in detail, all changes to the POA&M and reason/rationale
